analysis.title: The week in seven charts: Binance hit by a $6.3bn hack
key_insights: Binance suffered a hack with estimated losses of up to $6.3bn, which would be the largest crypto theft on record. About $3bn has been frozen so far and the exchange pledged to cover all losses. The final cost is still being assessed.

The stolen amount equals roughly 0.23% of total crypto market capitalisation, versus Mt. Gox 2014 at 5.84%, Bitfinex 2016 at 0.65% and The DAO 2016 at 0.43%. Syz says the incident ranks below several earlier breaches in relative terms.
Combined quarterly CapEx of the Big Four hyperscalers surpassed $200bn: Amazon about $77bn, Alphabet about $51bn, Microsoft about $39bn, Meta about $34bn.

ProAllocate's review of more than 120 outlooks from 76 firms found French government bonds (OATs) the most widely shared underweight, citing France's public finances and politics and a French-German 10-year spread at its widest since the euro debt crisis.

Within equities, asset managers are cautious on Consumer Staples, European Listed Real Estate and Australian equities. In fixed income, Long Duration, Low Quality Issuers and Global Investment Grade Credit scored low. Oil is unpopular after this year's sharp price swings, and cash remains an underweight.

Equities are the clearest overweight in Q4 2026 outlooks: of 66 firms with a view, 52 were overweight, 11 neutral and 3 underweight. Managers cite double-digit earnings growth, resilient nominal growth and AI investment broadening beyond Big Tech.

Over 6-12 month tactical horizons, managers favour the US, emerging markets, Japan and AI-related stocks selectively. Local-currency EM debt is the only fixed income position in the top 10. Managers stay positive on gold, real assets, private infrastructure and commodities.

Anthropic generates $6.6mn revenue per employee, behind only OnlyFans ($33.0mn) and ahead of AppLovin ($6.1mn), Nvidia ($5.1mn), Netflix ($2.8mn), Meta ($2.5mn), Apple ($2.5mn) and Google ($2.1mn). Syz notes the metric says little about profitability or infrastructure costs.

The CAC 40 trades at its lowest valuation relative to the Eurozone on record per JPMorgan, after more than three years of underperformance. Sentiment on French assets is very depressed, and Syz leaves open whether the discount is an opportunity or prices in real risks.
Europe's share of global technology R&D fell from 23% in 2005 to 8% today, versus the US at 62% and China at 15%. South Korea invests more than Germany, France, the UK and Italy combined.

crypto_views: Binance hack estimated at up to $6.3bn, suspected to be the largest crypto theft on record, with about $3bn frozen and the exchange pledging to cover all losses.
The loss is about 0.23% of total crypto market cap, well below Mt. Gox at 5.84%, so Syz distinguishes a major operational failure from claims the whole industry is collapsing.
Syz says security concerns stand but should be weighed against the size of today's crypto market.
risk_factors: Binance's final financial cost is still being assessed and exchange security failures remain a concern.
The cautious minority on equities points to rate hikes, higher real yields and oil prices as risks.
French public finances and political situation weigh on French bonds and equities.

Cash remains an underweight despite improved sentiment since last quarter. Oil is unpopular after this year's sharp price swings.
